display.purpose: One major invitation or result per view.

body.purpose: Controls, navigation, forms, metadata, and ordinary UI copy.

reading.purpose: Passages, essays, teacher answers, and evidence.

mono.purpose: Paths, IDs, logs, and technical values in Settings only.

shadows.name: ambient-rest
shadows.purpose: Rare floating surface such as the active composer.

shadows.name: floating-control
shadows.purpose: Menus and dialogs that must separate from content.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, selection, and compact state changes.

motion.name: surface-enter
motion.purpose: A single page or primary surface entering; opacity and transform only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single highest-priority action on a surface.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--primary, #254C61); color: #fff; font: 700 12px/1.35 "Segoe UI Variable", "Microsoft YaHei UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover, #1B3B4C); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(31, 83, 109, 0.18); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #1976A5); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A restrained supporting action without competing with the primary verb.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #B7C1BB); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--ink, #18211F); font: 700 12px/1.35 "Segoe UI Variable", "Microsoft YaHei UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--primary, #254C61); background: var(--primary-soft, #E9F0F3); color: var(--primary, #254C61); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #1976A5); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A clearly labelled field for settings, filters, and short learner input.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--muted, #66736E); font: 700 12px/1.35 "Segoe UI Variable", "Microsoft YaHei UI", sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #B7C1BB); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--ink, #18211F); font: 400 14.5px/1.62 "Segoe UI Variable", "Microsoft YaHei UI", sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #1976A5); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: var(--focus, #1976A5); }

components.name: Learning Card
components.description: A flat, ruled content group for a task or result summary.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-learning-card { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #DDE3DF); border-left-color: var(--evidence, #0D6B62); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--ink, #18211F); font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Microsoft YaHei UI", sans-serif; } .ds-learning-card small { color: var(--muted, #66736E); font-size: 12px; } .ds-learning-card h3 { margin: 8px 0 4px; font-size: 17px; } .ds-learning-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted, #66736E); }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The current learning destination in the desktop rail.
components.html: 今天
components.css: .ds-nav-active { position: relative; min-height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #D1D8D4; border-radius: 7px; background: #FAFBFA; color: var(--evidence, #0D6B62); text-decoration: none; font: 650 14px/1.4 "Segoe UI Variable", "Microsoft YaHei UI", sans-serif; } .ds-nav-active::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 -10px; width: 3px; background: var(--evidence, #0D6B62); } .ds-nav-active svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #1976A5); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: A compact state label, not an action or heading.
components.css: .ds-status { min-height: 24px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid #EAD2AE; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--warning-soft, #FBF0DF); color: var(--warning, #A4641B); font: 700 11px/1.35 "Segoe UI Variable", "Microsoft YaHei UI", sans-serif; }

components.name: Study Composer
components.description: The floating transition between conversation input and editorial teaching output.
components.css: .ds-composer { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #CFD6D2; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); box-shadow: 0 9px 25px rgba(30, 49, 43, 0.07); } .ds-composer textarea { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 56px; resize: none; padding: 14px 18px 4px; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #18211F); font: 400 15px/1.55 "Segoe UI Variable", "Microsoft YaHei UI", sans-serif; } .ds-composer > div { min-height: 42px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 0 8px 7px 9px; } .ds-composer button { width: 36px; height: 36px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #18211F); cursor: pointer; } .ds-composer button:hover { background: var(--surface-muted, #F2F4F1); } .ds-composer button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #1976A5); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-composer svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; } .ds-composer .ds-send { border-radius: 11px; background: var(--evidence, #0D6B62); color: #fff; font-size: 20px; }

narrative.northStar: The Academic Reading Room / 学术阅读室
narrative.overview: IELTS Study Desk should feel like a quiet place where serious learning becomes easier to begin: editorial enough to invite reading, structured enough to support a timed exam, and restrained enough that the learner's passage, answer, essay, or conversation remains the dominant object. The product is not a generic AI chat shell and not a school administration dashboard. It is an IELTS teacher's desk expressed as a local desktop application. The visual system combines a paper-like neutral field, measured typography, one-pixel rules, and sparse semantic color. It may learn from DeepTutor's calm proportions, generous reading widths, and state-dependent chat composition, but it must retain its own IELTS identity, evidence-led teaching language, four-module workflows, and local-first trust model. No visual resource may require a network request at runtime.
keyCharacteristics: Calm academic editorial tone, never sterile enterprise software.
Paper, ink, ruled divisions, and an evidence margin instead of decorative dashboards.
A compact global shell with learning in the foreground and configuration kept inside Settings.
Flat by default; elevation appears only for floating controls, overlays, and the active composer.
Serif typography earns attention on reading and reflection; sans-serif typography manages the application.
Motion is brief, interruptible, and subordinate to input latency and scroll stability.

rules.name: The Two Accents Rule
rules.body: Oxford blue means action; evidence teal means verified learning evidence. Never swap them merely to add variety.

rules.name: The Rare Warning Rule
rules.body: Amber and red must remain visually scarce. If a screen appears warm or red at a glance, warning color is being overused.

rules.name: The Paper Continuity Rule
rules.body: Large reading and conversation regions remain on the reading-paper field; do not fragment them into alternating tinted cards.

rules.name: The Serif Earns Attention Rule
rules.body: Serif is for reading, reflection, and the one major invitation on a page. Navigation, controls, tables, and settings remain sans-serif.

rules.name: The One Display Rule
rules.body: A viewport may have one display-sized statement. Additional headings must step down decisively instead of competing.

rules.name: The Comfortable Measure Rule
rules.body: Teacher answers and passages must be constrained by reading measure, not merely by the available screen width.

rules.name: The One Scroll Owner Rule
rules.body: Each primary view has one obvious scroll container. Split practice panes may scroll internally, but the surrounding page must remain stable.

rules.name: The Reading Axis Rule
rules.body: Long-form content aligns to a consistent 960–980px axis even on very wide displays; extra width becomes breathing room, not longer lines.

rules.name: The No Reflow Surprise Rule
rules.body: Loading, streaming, model changes, and attachment processing reserve their space and must not shift the learner's current reading position.

rules.name: The Flat by Default Rule
rules.body: If a border, spacing change, or surface tone can express hierarchy, do not add a shadow.

rules.name: The State Creates Depth Rule
rules.body: Elevation should explain that an element is floating, active, or transient; it is never ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Radius Has Meaning Rule
rules.body: Small radii mean controls, medium radii mean content groups, and the large composer radius means active dialogue. Do not choose a radius by visual whim.

rules.name: The No Nested Bubbles Rule
rules.body: One content idea gets one container. Metadata, attachments, and actions should sit inside its rhythm rather than each receiving another rounded box.

dos: Do make the learner's passage, question, essay, recording, or teacher answer the largest object on the page.
Do separate learning surfaces from Settings and advanced model or Agent configuration.
Do use meaningful titles and IELTS classifications instead of internal IDs, full-mock, or engineering status strings.
Do preserve original question structure, answer constraints, passage formatting, and evidence anchors.
Do keep navigation, the active model, save state, and the next action visible without turning them into competing cards.
Do keep all fonts, icons, and visual assets offline-capable and test Windows first with full macOS and Linux usability.
Do measure scroll stability, input response, bundle growth, long-list behavior, keyboard flow, reduced motion, and 200% zoom before calling a visual pass complete.
donts: Don't turn Today into a dashboard of metrics, queues, provider details, and repeated cards.
Don't copy DeepTutor's logo, illustrations, exact component styling, or general-purpose product architecture; extract only transferable proportion and interaction principles.
Don't use remote fonts, CDN icons, decorative gradients, glass panels, or shadows as a substitute for hierarchy.
Don't wrap every paragraph, attachment, status, and action in its own rounded rectangle.
Don't expose raw runtime, schema, HTTP, OAuth, or CLI errors in the learning flow.
Don't auto-scroll a conversation after the learner has moved away from the bottom.
Don't let a visual redesign weaken IELTS answer integrity, active revision, speaking mock integrity, privacy consent, or Runtime validation.
